c74object.name: evi.comb~
c74object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP comb~ filter delay
c74object.description:
evi.comb~ is a 'max define' for the evi_comb.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.comb~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Comb filter delay unit with saturation in the feedback path. The same structure as MSP comb~, but with cubic interpolation (softer in the high end) and no digital clipping at FB Gain == 1 (via internal saturation, which makes the whole filter softer but will not clip your precious audio).

inlet.description: Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the input path.
Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedforward path.
Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedback path.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.
